translations.b0408: Part 13  Accelerating the Comprehensive Green Transformation of Economic and Social Development and Building a Beautiful China
translations.b0409: Firmly establish and practice the principle that lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets, take carbon peaking and carbon neutrality as the guiding force and the improvement of the institutional systems for ecological civilization as the guarantee, pursue coordinated progress in cutting carbon emissions, reducing pollution, expanding green development and promoting growth, improve the quality of the ecological environment, build solid ecological security barriers, and strengthen the momentum for green development.
translations.b0410: Chapter 47  Actively and Prudently Advancing and Achieving Carbon Peaking
translations.b0411: Coordinate development and emissions reduction, carry out carbon peaking actions in a solid manner, accelerate the adjustment and optimization of the industrial, energy and transport structures, and ensure that the carbon peaking target is achieved on schedule.
translations.b0412: Section 1  Fully Implementing the System of Dual Control over Total Carbon Emissions and Carbon Emission Intensity
translations.b0413: Combine policy guidance with market incentives and steadily implement policies and systems such as local carbon assessments, sectoral carbon control, enterprise carbon management, project carbon evaluation and product carbon footprints. Establish a comprehensive evaluation and assessment system for carbon peaking and carbon neutrality, break down the dual carbon control targets in a scientific and rational manner, and ensure that responsibility for delivering on carbon emissions targets is firmly shouldered. Establish a sectoral carbon emission control mechanism, clarify carbon emission management requirements for key sectors and fields, and advance capacity governance and dual carbon control in a coordinated way. Improve the management systems for key energy-using and carbon-emitting entities. Strengthen energy conservation reviews and carbon emission evaluations for fixed-asset investment projects, and require new, expanded and renovated energy-intensive and high-emission industrial projects to implement equivalent or reduced carbon emission replacement. Formulate rules and standards for product carbon footprint accounting, release carbon emission cap standards for key products, and establish a product carbon labeling and certification system. Improve the carbon emission statistics and accounting system and the dynamic monitoring and early warning mechanism, and compile the national greenhouse gas inventory on a regular basis. Expand the coverage of the national carbon emissions trading market and accelerate the development of the trading market for voluntary greenhouse gas emission reductions.
translations.b0414: Section 2  Promoting Energy Conservation and Carbon Reduction in Key Areas
translations.b0415: Carry out in-depth energy conservation and carbon reduction retrofits, step up efforts to control and reduce coal consumption, accelerate the meeting of incremental electricity demand with newly added clean energy generation, promote the peaking of coal and oil consumption, and reduce energy consumption per unit of GDP by around 10 percent. Effectively manage energy-intensive and high-emission projects, accelerate the innovation and application of green and low-carbon technologies and equipment, orderly relocate eligible energy-intensive industries to regions rich in renewable energy resources, and build zero-carbon factories and industrial parks. Strengthen energy conservation and carbon reduction retrofits of existing buildings and municipal facilities, promote the development of ultra-low-energy and prefabricated buildings on a large scale, and implement actions to improve cooling efficiency and promote green lighting. Accelerate the green and low-carbon transformation of heating systems, promote the use of waste heat and non-fossil energy for heating in light of local conditions, and orderly advance metering-based heating retrofits and heat-based billing. Promote the low-carbon substitution of transport power sources, accelerate electrification in the freight and public sectors and the application of green-fuel vehicles and vessels, and increase the share of bulk cargo transported by rail and water and the share of transport carried by new energy vehicles. Improve energy efficiency in emerging fields such as computing power facilities and 5G base stations. Improve energy efficiency diagnostic mechanisms in key fields and further implement the energy efficiency labeling system and the energy efficiency “front-runner” system. Further develop pioneering zones for green, low-carbon and high-quality development.
translations.b0416: Section 3  Enhancing Capacity to Respond to Global Climate Change
translations.b0417: Place equal emphasis on mitigation and adaptation, bring greenhouse gas emissions under comprehensive control, and actively respond to the adverse effects and risks of climate change. Strengthen the monitoring and control of non-carbon dioxide greenhouse gases, increase the carbon sink increment of ecosystems, and improve the carbon sink monitoring and accounting system. Improve the climate change adaptation framework, strengthen assessments of the risks and impacts of climate change on key vulnerable sectors and regions, and enhance capacity to respond to climate change, especially extreme weather. Actively participate in and lead global climate governance, uphold the principle of common but differentiated responsibilities, fully implement the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change and its Paris Agreement, and deepen South-South cooperation on climate change.
translations.b0418: Chapter 48  Continuing to Improve Environmental Quality
translations.b0419: Adhere to environmental protection for the people, fully implement targeted, scientific and law-based pollution control, place greater emphasis on source control, strengthen coordination between pollution reduction and carbon reduction, between the control of multiple pollutants and between regional governance efforts, and accelerate the shift of environmental quality improvement from quantitative accumulation to qualitative change.
translations.b0420: Section 1  Deepening the Battles to Keep the Skies Blue, the Waters Clear and the Land Clean
translations.b0421: Continue to deepen the battle against pollution and improve the quality of the atmospheric, water and soil environments to higher standards. Take key regions such as the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region and its surrounding areas, the Yangtze River Delta and the Fenwei Plain as the main battlegrounds, strengthen control of fine particulate matter (PM2.5), further advance ultra-low emission retrofits in key industries, promote source substitution and whole-process treatment of volatile organic compounds, set the next-stage standards for motor vehicle emissions and fuel quality, deepen tiered management of atmospheric environmental performance, reduce emissions of nitrogen oxides and volatile organic compounds by more than 8 percent each, and further eliminate heavily polluted weather. Strengthen air pollution prevention and control in the middle reaches of the Yangtze River, the Chengdu-Chongqing region and other areas. Strengthen the treatment of cooking fume, odor and environmental noise pollution. Take coordinated action on water resources, the water environment and the aquatic ecosystem, focus on solving prominent problems across whole river basins and across provincial boundaries, strengthen the systematic governance and ecological protection of major rivers, lakes and reservoirs, basically complete the investigation and remediation of sewage outfalls into rivers and the sea in key river basins and sea areas, reduce chemical oxygen demand and total phosphorus emissions by 6 percent each, consolidate the results of urban black and odorous water body treatment, and basically eliminate black and odorous water bodies in counties and townships. Strengthen source prevention and control of soil pollution and promote the safe use of contaminated farmland and construction land.
translations.b0422: Section 2  Strengthening Environmental Risk Prevention and Control
translations.b0423: Bring ecological and environmental risks under routine control and effectively safeguard public health and safety. Implement a comprehensive solid waste treatment action, actively advance source reduction, process control, end-of-pipe utilization and full-chain non-hazardous management, and improve standardized control over solid waste disposal. Strengthen whole-process supervision of hazardous waste, focus on controlling heavy metal pollution risks, and carry out the investigation and remediation of hidden dangers left over from the past in slag, mines, tailings ponds and other sites. Further advance the treatment of emerging pollutants and establish a system for the coordinated treatment and risk control of persistent organic pollutants, endocrine disruptors, antibiotics, microplastics and other pollutants. Promote high-standard design, high-quality construction and high-level operation of nuclear facilities, strengthen safety supervision of first-of-a-kind and new reactors, strengthen the decommissioning and remediation of aging facilities and the disposal of radioactive waste, and enhance radiation environment monitoring capacity. Improve the emergency response system for environmental emergencies involving cross-regional and cross-departmental coordination. Carry out ecological and environmental health risk assessments in key regions.
translations.b0424: Section 3  Improving the Modern Environmental Governance System
translations.b0425: Implement the Ecological Environment Code, improve the responsibility system, the regulatory system and the system of laws, regulations and standards, and enhance the effectiveness of environmental governance. Ensure that Party committees and governments at all levels and leading officials fulfill their responsibilities for ecological and environmental protection, further advance central and provincial ecological and environmental protection inspections, and improve inspection support capacity and the modernization of monitoring and supervision. Continue to develop national ecological civilization pilot zones. Carry out performance assessments of Beautiful China development and build Beautiful China pioneer zones. Further advance zoning-based ecological and environmental control, strengthen alignment with territorial space planning, and jointly optimize the industrial layout. Accelerate the implementation of a supervision system for stationary pollution sources centered on the pollutant discharge permit system. Update pollutant discharge and environmental quality standards and build an environmental credit supervision system.
translations.b0426: Chapter 49  Enhancing the Diversity, Stability and Sustainability of Ecosystems
translations.b0427: Uphold integrated protection and systematic governance of mountains, rivers, forests, farmland, lakes, grasslands and deserts, coordinate natural restoration and artificial restoration, place greater emphasis on improving quality, developing industries and benefiting the people, and build a major framework for protection and governance stretching from the mountain tops to the sea.
translations.b0428: Section 1  Consolidating and Improving Ecological Security Barriers
translations.b0429: Coordinate the advancement of major projects for the protection and restoration of important ecosystems, and continue to consolidate the national ecological security barrier system with the “three zones and four belts” as its framework. Intensify the battle to advance the Three-North Shelterbelt Program and secure a decisive victory in its three landmark campaigns. Further advance ecological protection of the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau and strengthen the control of soil erosion and rocky desertification in key regions. Carry out large-scale national greening initiatives on a scientific basis, promote the precise improvement of forest quality and the development of national reserve forests, increase forest stock volume to 22.4 billion cubic meters, coordinate grassland ecological restoration and rational utilization, and strengthen wetland protection and restoration. Advance the treatment of over-diversion of surface water and over-extraction of groundwater, and carry out ecological restoration of abandoned mines left over from the past.
translations.b0430: Section 2  Comprehensively Advancing the Development of the Protected Natural Areas System
translations.b0431: Carry out the integration and optimization of protected natural areas, implement tiered management and zoning-based control, and establish a sound system of protected natural areas with national parks as the mainstay. Establish new national parks in an orderly manner and improve the ecological service functions of nature reserves and nature parks. Implement major biodiversity conservation projects, focus on the protection of flagship and key species, strengthen the protection and restoration of important habitats, ecological corridors and migratory bird flyways, continue to strengthen the protection of aquatic life in the Yangtze River, develop a national botanical garden system, and strengthen the protection of ancient and famous trees. Strengthen forest and grassland fire prevention and control and pest control, and strengthen the monitoring and control of invasive alien species.
translations.b0433: Place equal emphasis on strict constraints and stronger incentives in order to stimulate an internal impetus within the whole of society to protect the ecology. Strictly implement the management system for ecological conservation red lines, strengthen the investigation and remediation of ecological damage, and carry out assessments of the effectiveness of ecological protection and restoration. Improve the property rights and management systems for natural resource assets and comprehensively advance asset surveys and accounting and the confirmation and registration of rights. Improve the diversified ecological compensation mechanism, improve transfer payments to key ecological function zones and compensation policies for important ecosystems such as forests and grasslands, improve the dynamic adjustment mechanism for compensation standards, carry out in-depth horizontal compensation with a focus on river basins, develop market-based ecological compensation, and explore comprehensive ecological compensation. Expand channels for realizing the value of ecological products in light of local conditions. Improve the ecological and environmental damage compensation system. Deepen reform of the collective forest tenure system and state-owned forest areas and accelerate the development of modern state-owned forest farms.
translations.b0434: Chapter 50  Accelerating the Formation of Green Modes of Production and Ways of Life
translations.b0435: Give prominence to conservation as a priority, strengthen policy incentives and guide the whole of society to participate, accelerate the green and low-carbon transformation of development modes, and foster new green modes of production and new lifestyles.
translations.b0436: Section 1  Strengthening the Economical and Intensive Use of Resources
translations.b0437: Improve the systems for total resource volume management and comprehensive conservation, and strengthen whole-process management and full-chain conservation of water, land, mineral and other resources. Improve the level of intensive and safe water use, fully implement the rigid water resource constraint system, strengthen water conservation to increase efficiency in agriculture, reduce emissions in industry and cut losses in urban areas, reduce water consumption per unit of GDP by 10 percent, and raise the effective utilization coefficient of irrigation water to 0.6. Improve the efficiency of construction land use, promote the application of land-saving technologies and models, and keep newly added construction land within 26 million mu. Improve the comprehensive utilization of mineral resources and comprehensively advance green exploration and green mine development. Promote the development of the circular economy, improve the waste recycling system, and, on the premise of ensuring zero imports of solid waste, orderly advance the import and utilization of high-quality recycled raw materials from overseas, develop and expand the remanufacturing industry, and bring the annual utilization of bulk solid waste to around 4.5 billion tonnes.
translations.b0438: Section 2  Improving the Green Development Policy System
translations.b0439: Innovate protection and investment incentive mechanisms and implement fiscal, tax, financial, investment, pricing, scientific and technological, and environmental protection policies that promote green and low-carbon development. Optimize the green tax system, carry out pilot programs for levying environmental protection tax on volatile organic compounds, and implement tax incentives that support resource conservation and the use of green products. Enrich green financial products and services, orderly advance innovation in carbon financial products and derivatives, improve the green finance assessment and evaluation system for financial institutions, and encourage a higher share of investment in green and low-carbon fields. Improve the green certificate trading mechanism and improve pricing policies that encourage flexible power sources to participate in system regulation. Establish a sound green and low-carbon standards system and work to lead the improvement of international rules and standards and their alignment and mutual recognition.
translations.b0440: Section 3  Launching a Nationwide Green and Low-Carbon Action
translations.b0441: Vigorously advocate a simple and moderate, green and low-carbon, civilized and healthy philosophy of life and mode of consumption. Guide the public to save water and electricity, oppose extravagance and waste, promote the “Clear Plate” campaign, resist excessive packaging, reduce the use of single-use products, accelerate the development of “bamboo as a substitute for plastic”, and give priority to green travel. Encourage enterprises to improve green design and manufacturing and to reduce the energy and resource consumption and ecological and environmental impact of products throughout their life cycles. Improve waste sorting and resource recovery. Improve incentive mechanisms for green consumption and expand the scope and scale of government procurement of green products.
